question: What lordship over the lotus and quality of firmness are ascribed to the deity in obeisance?
premises: The deity is addressed as the lord dwelling in the lotus.
The deity is addressed as firm.
Obeisance is offered to these aspects.
inference: The deity is honored as the steady lord associated with the lotus.
plain_english: Obeisance to the lord dwelling in the lotus; obeisance to the firm one.
